items.name: Hilliard Hippocampus XII 2023

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be emailed once registration closes

items.information: This competition is on a **Thursday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

items.name: Middleton FMC 2023
items.information: This competition only holds the Fewest Moves Challenge Event and not the regular 3x3 event. You can find how it works [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonFMC2023#36676-what-is-fmc). There is no registration fee for this competition, so we highly recommend you give it a try! On [Tuesday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupTuesday2023) and [Thursday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupThursday2023), we will be holding competitions with 3x3 at the same venue in the evening. Those competitions are in series with each other, but you are allowed to compete in one of those as well as this FMC competition. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHBaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--775eb9d886ae63e1625875da78d648ae4bc7e286/image.png)

items.name: Middleton Meetup Thursday 2023
items.information: This competition is being held in series with [Middleton Meetup Tuesday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupTuesday2023#general-info). You may only register for one of the two competitions. If you are interested in FMC, we will be holding an FMC mean directly before this competition at [Middleton FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonFMC2023) for free! That competition is not part of this series, so you are able to compete in both this competition as well as the FMC competition. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHBaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--775eb9d886ae63e1625875da78d648ae4bc7e286/image.png)

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final: Spökboll - 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the final competition of the autumn season of Stockholmsligan 2023!
